gloss: to get to know, to become acquainted

definitions.gloss: to get to know, to become acquainted
definitions.explanation: To meet and become familiar with someone; to form an acquaintance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧で⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧と{知|し}り{合|あ}った。
examples.english: I got to know him at university.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧は⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧を⟦{通|とお}じて→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧{知|し}り{合|あ}った。
examples.english: The two of them got to know each other through work.

examples.japanese: {知|し}り{合|あ}ってからもう10⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧になる。
examples.english: It's been 10 years since we met.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧{先|さき}で⟦{偶然|ぐうぜん}→偶然：02674_guuzen⟧{知|し}り{合|あ}った⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧と⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧になった。
examples.english: I became friends with someone I happened to meet while traveling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧とは⟦{共通|きょうつう}→共通：02590_kyoutsuu⟧の⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧を⟦{通|とお}じて→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧{知|し}り{合|あ}いました。
examples.english: I got to know my wife through a mutual friend.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive). Pattern: Xと{知|し}り{合|あ}う.

{知|し}り{合|あ}う is formed from ⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧ (to know) + ⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ (mutual action). The ⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ suffix indicates both parties participate.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{知|し}り{合|あ}い→知り合い：03253_shiriai⟧ (acquaintance - noun form)
- ⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧ (to know)
- ⟦{出会|であ}う→出会う：02298_deau⟧ (to meet, encounter)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～で{知|し}り{合|あ}う (to meet at ~)
- ～を⟦{通|とお}じて→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧{知|し}り{合|あ}う (to meet through ~)
- {知|し}り{合|あ}って～⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (have known each other for ~ years)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {知|し}り{合|あ}う: to become acquainted (emphasis on getting to know)
- ⟦{出会|であ}う→出会う：02298_deau⟧: to meet (initial encounter)
- ⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧: to meet (general)
